status: POST-HOC second-stage development comparison; see SELECTION_RULE_DISCLOSURE.md. Declared before any PROTOCOL_V2 result was computed.
data: DEV only (v8 train+val). v8 test, v10, QuixBugs, BugsInPy are not read.

C0_V6B_as_frozen.policy: frozen recipe: median impute WITH missing-indicator, no gating

C1_V6B_minusE.note: E columns (alpha,conf,status one-hots) are metadata only

C2_V6B_minusE_minusA.note: A removed: non-contributing in the earlier ablation (+0.003, Holm p=0.40)

policy_P1: Predictive vector excludes all E columns. Imputation: median, NO missing indicator. Classifier is trained on all DEV training pairs with original labels. At scoring time, pairs whose status is NOT_ACTIVATED or UNKNOWN are ABSTAINED: their score is the median of the activated training pairs' scores of the same fold. Abstention is never treated as evidence of equivalence. Both all-pairs (headline) and activated-only AUROC are reported, with the abstention rate and the label mix of abstained pairs.
primary_metric: AUROC of 3-seed (42,43,44) mean OOF LR scores under P1, all pairs, alone (oracle-free). Same folds as before (5-fold program-grouped; inner GroupKFold(3) tuning).
selection: Same rule shape as the original operationalisation: best primary AUROC; eligible = candidates whose paired program-cluster-bootstrap (B=2000, seed 42) 95% CI of delta vs best contains 0 AND whose lower 95% bound of delta vs best is > -0.02 on each edit-size tertile and on pooled LOFO; ties to the fewest features. Candidates compared: C0g, C1, C2 (C0_as_frozen is a reference, not a candidate).
R_regime: d_R, delta_out are NEVER candidate features. Reported only in a separate R2 regime (CONV+DIFF, candidate+R).
reproduction: All features re-extracted from raw sources into artifacts/v6/repro/ and compared with saved features; every model re-fit (no saved OOF reuse).
